name: Sunny Bunnies
description: Furry little bunnies hop through wild adventures as they find solutions, fun and sometimes mischief wherever there is light.

videos.title: Merry-Go-Round
videos.overview: The Sunny Bunnies appear at an empty theme park and want a ride on their favourite merry-go-round.

videos.title: Magic Eraser
videos.overview: Iris gives a lesson of magical transformations. Sunny Bunnies repeat the magical movements, and only Hopper manages to come up with an unusual eraser that can rub out everything.

videos.title: Sunny Racers
videos.overview: Sunny Bunnies turn into drivers of shiny racing cars and arrange a competition. The Big Gray Wolf, who once again tries to catch the Bunnies, becomes a participant in this race against his will.

videos.title: Fun Ski Jumping
videos.overview: Sunny Bunnies are having lots of fun ski jumping, and it's a good thing S-Marty joins them after they get stuck in a huge snowdrift and need his help.

videos.title: Little Detectives
videos.overview: Something awful has happened, Iris has lost her bow. It's time for the famous detective Turbo Holmes to take matters into his own paws.

videos.title: Valentine Party
videos.overview: The Bunnies are decorating the park with paper hearts for Valentine's Day, but S-Marty doesn't understand why and thinks all paper is rubbish.

videos.title: Little Ones Are Not Allowed
videos.overview: Hopper wants to go on a ride in a far away corner of the park. Unfortunately, he's too small. But little bunnies don't give up and Hopper finds a safe way to jump on the ride.

videos.title: Brand New Game
videos.overview: For some strange reason, butterflies don't seem to like being photographed. But curious scouts Shiny and Iris don't give up - no matter how tricky it might be.

videos.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
videos.overview: Big Boo wishes for a delicious doughnut when he sees a star falling from the sky, but the Sunny Bunnies know that the right thing to do is to put the star back in the sky.

videos.title: The Most Nimble
videos.overview: Who's the most nimble among the Sunny Bunnies? To find out, the bunnies compete against each other to try and overcome the most difficult obstacle course ever.

videos.title: Boo's Super Scooter
videos.overview: Big Boo arrives on a weird, flashing, two-wheeled thing that all the bunnies think is super cool and they want to have a go on it.

videos.title: Little Builders
videos.overview: Building a house is more complicated than the Bunnies thought, but the little Sunny builders are determined to finish their building.

videos.title: Modern Art
videos.overview: Everything at the museum should be hung evenly and precisely but the cheerful Sunny Bunny visitors aren't always quiet and well-behaved.

videos.title: The Tale of the Carrot
videos.overview: The Sunny Bunnies have grown a great crop on the farm but little Hopper has only grown a small carrot; he tries to find a way to win the contest.

videos.title: Boo the Genie
videos.overview: The Sunny Bunnies accidentally release a genie who might be the sloppiest of his kind. They should probably forget about getting their wishes fulfilled.

videos.title: Sunny Bunnies Tractor Band
videos.overview: The first and only concert of the world-famous Sunshine band is held at the sunny farm, where all fans are welcome and admission is free.

videos.title: Music for All
videos.overview: Sunny Bunnies love to play sports with music playing; Iris and Shiny prefer a calm melody, Big Boo loves running a fast dance rhythm, and Hopper and Turbo listen to country music; learn what music is the right fit for everyone.

videos.title: Iris's Birthday
videos.overview: Birthday girl Iris is waiting for her friends for a party and has baked a delicious cake for them, but trouble ensues when the cake starts running away from the guests.

videos.title: Puzzling Time
videos.overview: Iris and Shiny are the fastest puzzle-solvers in the world; they can put together any puzzle, but there's just one problem: the last piece is missing.

videos.title: Magnificent Magnet
videos.overview: The Sunny Bunnies desire to get candy out of the candy machine, and use a magnet to get what they want.

videos.title: Cool Superpower
videos.overview: Shiny has accidentally gained a superpower to freeze everything around her; now she can make ice cream from milk and an ice rink from a pool.

videos.title: Magical Flute
videos.overview: Can you make your friends do exactly want you ask? Well, the mischievous Hopper is pretty good at it. Playing his magic flute, he makes his friends dance non-stop.

videos.title: The Halloween Fairy
videos.overview: Sunny Bunnies are going to a Halloween party, but clumsy Big Boo knocks over all the fruit baskets. What should he do? Call the magic fairy, of course.

videos.title: Gummy Boo
videos.overview: There is Ant-Man, Spider-Man, and Bubble-gum-Man; a Sunny Bunny has the unique ability to move around the park with the help of bubblegum.

videos.title: Magic Lab
videos.overview: Iris is a tireless inventor of magic spells; in her lab, she creates new powders and potions; the trouble is that her friends don't have the same skills, and make a mess.

videos.title: Cosmic Christmas Tree
videos.overview: The Sunny Bunnies have decorated many different Christmas trees, but this year something totally unbelievable awaits them.

videos.title: Mummy Bunny
videos.overview: There's a super-old sarcophagus in the ancient museum and whoever wears the mummy's outfit can pass through walls. What will naughty Hopper do when he puts it on?

videos.title: Dizzy Little Bunny
videos.overview: The most amazing things can be found in an antique chest. Vintage toys, a hat, a rattle and a special surprise: Sunny Bunnies Magic Mask.

videos.title: Sunny Bunnies Magic Mask
videos.overview: If you ride the merry-go-round for too long, you get dizzy, but Hopper knows no limits and continues to spin until his friends stop the carousel.

videos.title: Scientific Experiment
videos.overview: Turbo invented a super-mega-sophisticated scientific machine that can turn anything into anything else. It's a global sensation! However, the inventor himself cannot predict what the result will be.

videos.title: Megamuffin
videos.overview: Shiny and Iris decided to bake some small cupcakes. They mix all the ingredients correctly and carefully. But Big Boo has his own recipe - the bigger the cupcake, the better!

videos.title: Magic Fertilizer
videos.overview: Shiny has a wonderful magic potion for growing plants. One drop is enough to grow an entire tree with juicy fruits and vegetables. And what if you use this potion on a Sunny Bunny?

videos.title: Goalkeeper
videos.overview: Careless playing of football can be the cause of injury. That's exactly what happened to Hopper - he hit his leg and now he's lying in bed. But his friends won't let him get bored for long.

videos.title: Useful Magic Trick
videos.overview: Knowing how to pull rabbits out of a magician's hat is a true art. But pulling delicious ice cream out of a baseball cap is not just an art, but an absolutely essential skill for sweet-toothed Boo.
